story_note: Phil returns to his morning puzzle, noticing today's clues twist differently and require patience.
continuation_note: Having made steady progress, Phil looks forward to a return visit tomorrow with renewed enthusiasm for the next puzzle challenge.

scenes.title: Back Again
scenes.beat: Return after yesterday, new daily puzzle, same habit
scenes.dialogue: Another morning, a fresh puzzle awaits.
scenes.caption: Phil sips tea, ready to start.

scenes.title: Different Start
scenes.beat: The first move shows today's puzzle is different
scenes.caption: A twist in the first clue appears.
scenes.screen_state: puzzle partially filled in a few squares

scenes.title: The Pushback
scenes.beat: A fair stuck moment, no guessing
scenes.dialogue: No guesses now, time to pause and think.
scenes.caption: Phil pauses, mulling over tricky clues.

scenes.title: The Column
scenes.dialogue: At last, this column clicks perfectly!
scenes.caption: A vital breakthrough unlocks logic.

scenes.title: The Follow-Through
scenes.dialogue: Now the rest unfolds step by step.
scenes.caption: Answers start fitting together smoothly.

scenes.title: Worth Returning For
scenes.beat: Completion or honest latest progress, return tomorrow
scenes.dialogue: Almost done; I’ll finish this tomorrow.
scenes.caption: Progress made, eager for a return visit.
scenes.screen_state: puzzle partially completed awaiting final answers

style_rules: No masthead inside individual scene art.
Sapiver Press logo/title only on merchandise and monitor/browser URL.
Story text must continue from previous episode, not repeat a fixed template.
Puzzle screen must be composited from real capture, not invented by image generation.
The scene should be comic illustration, not photorealism.
